notes.content:
SFXEngine v2.07 is now live.

Two changes in this update:
-New, much more detailed statistics calculated when Save Stats is selected. Results show: Filename, Length, Length (Samples), Description/Notes (left empty for user notes), RMS Total (dB), Max Peak (dB), Max Peak (1/Peak), Samples Clipped, RMS [L] (dB), Max Peak [L] (dB), Peaks [L] -ve/+ve, Samples Clipped [L], RMS [R] (dB), Max Peak [R] (dB), Peaks [R] -ve/+ve, Samples Clipped [R].
-Ctrl and shift key status now reset when a message box appears. If held before, then released when a message box appears, the program loop would assume ctrl/shift was still held, giving the appearance of the keyboard being unresponsive.

notes.title: Welcome to SFXEngine v2.05, and Spring Sale Active
notes.content:
SFXEngine v2.05 is now live.

Two new engines in this update:
-Stone Compression is a mathematically ideal dynamic compressor. Compressors make loud sounds quieter and quiet sounds louder, and are most useful for equalising the volume of natural sounds like voices.
-Gothic Limiter will boost and limit the sound to a fixed Ceiling level, scaling everything between Floor and Sky to fit between Floor and Ceiling. Along with the Stone Compressor, this is another way to boost and equalise volume.
-The render format options, depth and stereo status are now stored between sessions.
-Plus a few smaller changes.

Details of the new engines in the manual, and full details of the update in the Readme.txt file.

SFXEngine and all of the Bolt-On DLC are currently on sale. The next SFXEngine release will be the Fantasy Sound Pack on 30th April.

notes.title: Welcome to 64-Bit SFXEngine v2.04
notes.content:
SFXEngine v2.04 is now live.

Something of a major update today, SFXEngine now works in 64-bit.

-Full conversion to 64-bit. This means a 10-20% speed increase and access to full memory footprint, permitting much larger projects.
-New V02 file format for projects and programs. V00 and V01 format files will import seamlessly. There are slight technical differences between formats due to improved timing accuracy with each subsequent format. As with every format change, files saved here won't load in older versions of SFXEngine.
-All engines recompiled in 64-bit and V02 format.
-Modulator maximum size increased to match the virtually unlimited maximum sample size.
-More preparations for multi-language support.

Full details in the Readme.txt file. The next SFXEngine release will be the Fantasy Sound Pack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438590/SFXEngine/

Happy Sound Making,

Mark

notes.title: SFXEngine Updated to v2.00
notes.content:
A major SFXEngine update is live today. SFXEngine v2.00 has a bunch of new features for new sound creation and batch audio processing. There's a new look, and about 25% of the core code has been rewritten. New features include:

-New sample structure with double pointers, permitting samples beyond 90 seconds and up to several hours (as memory permits).
-New double modulator pointers for increased accuracy.
-New global sample rate option to change the core program frequency. Projects and sounds remain compatible between sample rates and will automatically resample and remap, but all filters will need manual adjustment if resampling.
-New V01 file format for projects and programs. V00 format files will import seamlessly.
-New dynamically allocated floatutility and longutility variables for engines.
-New global transpose and tuning.
-New Revision number per project, incremented upon each save.
-Improved batch csv export to prevent infinite loops, and report if no files are found.
-Improved main wav loader to skip cue chunks.
-New Locate Usage option for samples and modulators will count all uses, and locate the next use, of the current sample or modulator.
-Lots of little bug fixes and improvements.

And more! The complete Bolt-On Bundle is live today too, with a 50% discount when purchasing all Bolt-On DLC. This will prepare the way for new preset/resource packs in 2025.

Find SFXEngine here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438590/SFXEngine/

And find the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38164/SFXEngine_Bolton_Full_Set/]Bolt-On Bundle[/url] here:

notes.title: SFXEngine Updated to v1.34
notes.content:
A new update to SFXEngine is now live. Lots of interesting changes here:

-Automatic resampling of samples to allow seamless loading of non-44100hz samples.
-Silence (zerosample) level and length now settable via the Project Menu to allow dynamic changes, inc. enable/disable.
-Fix to the linear sample interpolation, added cubic Hermite interpolation, and interpolation settings added to the Sample Menu.

One big change it that the demo now includes all DLC and DLC examples to demonstrate these important effects. In the demo, DLC engines are brown and labelled "(DLC)" to clearly differentiate them from the basic engines.

-Better dynamic resizing of sound list, engine list, environment list as used in Argus.
-The start of unlinking the system to 44100hz. A new start-up procedure and background options to unify the system to a potential new rate.
-Unified WAVEFORMAT structures, default buffer size set to 32768, and lots of other smaller changes.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438590/SFXEngine/

Enjoy creating,

Mark

notes.title: Argus Released
notes.content:
Hello All!

Our new animation software for Windows, Argus is out now. Argus uses 3D hardware and game technology to create animations in lightning-fast time.

The aim of Argus was to create a system where 3D objects (Actors) can be started and moved as quickly and easily as game sprites. Actors can be programmed move in exact ways using modulators attached to any axis of movement (or angle, or scale, or alpha transparency, and more...). If you need precise control, you can place objects in exact places on exact frames, and you can even use the mouse to move objects in real-time, recording exact movements.

Argus is free to use with limitations only to the quantity of tracks and frames. DLC can be purchased to expand tracks and frames to maximum. Find it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017550/Argus/

Argus is great tool for music videos, and it ships with templates for creating Spotify Canvas animations.

Happy animating!

Mark

notes.title: Gunstorm II Released
notes.content:
Thunderstorms rise again! Gunstorm II is released today, the explosive sequel to Gunstorm.

Like the first Gunstorm game, Gunstorm II is a rotary, arena space-shooter that uses mouse (or joy controller, or keys!) to rotate your ship.

Your sister, the beautiful princess Semele has been kidnapped by Kernag the Smeeb on the eve of her wedding to prince Caligulus. You have sworn to rescue her in your Gunstorm, the last fighter craft of the old league. Chase her though scrolling worlds, through the Caves of Marrowmor, through The Massive Mechanical Brain of Bonto Balmooni, and more!

You can choose a fixed or random level layout, and customise the game difficulty for infinite replay value as you face an armada of enemies which react to the player in unique ways. Use 8 different weapons which are collected and accessed Doom-style, and earn Gunstar Points to unlock sub-games.

Gunstorm II includes the 2007 Gunstorm song, with vocals by Tor James Faulkner. The Gunstorm EP, published by Cornutopia Music, includes several 1980s-style electronic pop tunes and is part of the Gunstorm DLC.

Find the game here, which is live now with a 10% launch discount:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2793560/Gunstorm_II/

Enjoy storming!

Mark

notes.title: Gunstorm Updated to v1.08
notes.content:
Greetings Starpilots!

The controls have been revamped to make mouse, keyboard, and game controller all active at the same time. Custom control options have been removed, and all controls are active at the same time, making it easy to play without the need to set things up. Here are the new controls:

Rotate Right: Horizontal Mouse, Keyboard Right Arrow, Keyboard D, Controller Left Analog Right
Rotate Left: Horizontal Mouse, Keyboard Left Arrow, Keyboard A, Controller Left Analog Left
Follow The Cursor Mode: Mouse, Keyboard WASD, Keyboard Arrow Keys, Controller Left Analog

Thrust: Right Mouse, Keyboard L Shift, Keyboard R Shift, Controller Left Trigger
Fire: Left Mouse, Keyboard R Ctrl, Keyboard L Ctrl, Controller Right Trigger, Controller A. Note that on an X-Box 360 style controller, it is not possible to detect a press of both trigger controls at the same time, so to fire and thrust at the same time, use A to fire.
Spider Bomb: Middle Mouse, Keyboard Return, Controller X, Controller Left Analog Click

Pause: Keyboard P, Controller 'Start'
Skip Story: Left Mouse, Keyboard Esc, Keyboard Spacebar, Keyboard R Ctrl, Keyboard L Ctrl, Controller Right Trigger, Controller A
Back/Abort: Keyboard Esc, Controller 'Back'

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2787740/Gunstorm/

Happy flying!

notes.title: Flatspace Updated
notes.content:
Greetings Starpilots!

Flatspace has had an upgrade and overhaul to match the capabilities of Flatspace IIk, and other new games like Gunstorm.

This is primarily an engine update, so there are no gameplay changes, but a lot has changed in the background, such as:
-New fonts, new lens flares, new starfield, and much better screen aspect support and improved graphics set-up.
-New separation of expert user options in Options.txt and game settings. Graveyard and settings are now stored in the Steam Cloud.
-Controls now support a full keyboard and (for future games!) 4 or more game controllers.

You'll notice a few things:
1. New fonts. The heading is less blurry and smaller on 16:9 screens, and the main font is better spaced.
2. New settings for expert users in Options.txt. There are two new options there: robustinit and fixaspect, plus fixes and upgrades to basic settings like screen resolution and timers.
3. Persistent settings and the graveyard are now backed up the Steam Cloud.
4. Better aspect-ratio support. The old 4:3 game is now transformed and looks largely the same at the 16:9 game. For other screens, the aspect can be fixed to stretch it if needed so that Flatspace should be playable on any shape or size of screen.
5. New starfield, new mouse pointer, new lens flares.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1210780/Flatspace/

Mark

notes.title: Gunstorm Released
notes.content:
Thunderstorms are rising! Our latest game, the space shooter Gunstorm is released today.

Gunstorm is a rotary, arena space-shooter that (by default) uses mouse left/right movements to rotate your ship, giving your craft huge manoeuvrability. You can also play with a 'follow the cursor' mouse mode, or using an X-Box 360 style game controller, or the keyboard if you prefer.

The plot is simple. Xodar of Gorn, in his vast battle-station, challenges you to 100 levels of alien craft. Each level has more enemies which appear faster. Each enemy reacts and moves in a different way. There are different level types too, from a level like arcade classic Asteroids where rocks are blasted into smaller and smaller chunks, to levels with static gun turrets, motherships and end-of-level guardians, and more surprises to discover.

You can choose a fixed or random level layout, and set the game speed, to make it as easy or as hard as you want. As well as the normal game you can choose to play stand-alone Asteroids, or the 'Onslaught' game featuring one huge level of different enemies. Gunstorm features games continues, automatically saves progress and settings in Steam Cloud, and awards a Steam Achievement if you defeat Xodar.

Gunstorm includes the classic theme music 'Deflexion', plus an optional remix of the 2007 Gunstorm song sung by Tor James Faulker. The Gunstorm EP (published by Cornutopia Music) includes several 1980s-style electronic pop tunes, and will be released on Steam as DLC in due course.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2787740/Gunstorm/

Enjoy battling Xodar!

Mark

notes.title: Future Pool and Future Snooker Updated
notes.content:
Future Pool and Future Snooker have been updated, just in time for the Steam Remote Play Together Sale which is active now.

In both games you'll discover:
-A new hi-res font and pointer.
-Better zoom handling, the screen now fixes height on different screens creating a much bigger display.
-A new control to centre the camera on the bat (Return or D-pad down on your controller).
-An extra rules page which lists mouse and camera keyboard controls.
-Steam Cloud support to keep settings between sessions.
-And lots more behind the scenes...

For expert users, the Options.txt file includes a few settings for custom display set-ups, such as setting a specific screen resolution. A new flag 'robustinit' can fix display freeze issues when using the desktop resolution on some systems; and 'fixaspect' which will stretch the screen rather than zoom, if you wanted to do that.

Future Pool, Future Snooker and Radioactive are all part of the Steam Remote Play Together Sale, and have 33% off for the next 7 days.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1177310/Future_Pool/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1177390/Future_Snooker/

Mark
